MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Gorilla glue felt useful for small household repairs where screws would be impractical, and its brush and nozzle would help me apply it precisely.",
    "Repair and mounting supplies connect with my recent fastener purchases, although that connection alone does not mean I need each item now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The finish nails resemble my recent framing nails, but their gauge and intended use do not match; a similar length does not make them interchangeable.",
    "The hanging-strip assortment does not address an unmet mounting need after my recent anchor purchase, and the bucket, reacher, and caulk caps lack a specific current use.",
    "The waterproof adhesive offers a capability I do not currently need, while the smaller Gorilla glue suits the precise repairs I would consider."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in framing nails seems to have been treated as interest in any kind of nail, regardless of tool compatibility or purpose.",
    "My household-supply purchases seem to have been stretched into a broad need for utility products; buying medicine cups does not imply that I need exam gloves."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The framing purpose, collation angle, and fastener dimensions in my recent nail purchases matter more than simply matching the word nails.",
    "I choose supplies for particular tasks, so general usefulness is insufficient when I have no immediate application or have recently bought something for that need."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions recognized my household repair interests but often missed the specific task, compatibility, and immediate need that determine whether I would buy."
}
